description: This source file defines the LicenseDao class in the OrangeHRM system, providing data access methods for license entities such as saving, retrieving by ID or name, listing, counting, verifying existence, and deleting licenses. It's part of the Admin plugin's Data Access Object layer.

classes.name: LicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object providing methods to interact with License entities in the database, including CRUD operations, searches, and list management.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Persists a License entity to the database.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a License entity by its name, removing whitespace before the match.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of License entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for License listings based on search filters.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of License entities matching the search filters.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple License entities identified by a list of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a License with the specified name already exists.

methods.name: getExistingLicenseIds
methods.description: Retrieves existing License IDs from a provided list of IDs.
